projects.title: Who would have said?
projects.description: The humanitarian activities of the Rugove Corporation over the years have encouraged us to work with a lot of dedication and a lot of love to produce a unique advertisement.

data.content: Rugove Corporation is one of the most popular corporations in Kosova. Established in the second half of 2006, located in Rugova Mountains, has been bringing the best of nature from its birthplace to every home in Kosova, and now abroad as well.

We serve Rugove with great pride, apart from social media management, on their 15th Birthday, we did the advert “Who would have said…?”, that best shows their big heart through the amazing work they did with their social campaigns over the years.
